title: 第670章 万花主宰的来意第669章 相互试探
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
随着李北玄的声音落下。
便看到李光宇带着一位女子从飞舟之上飞驶出来。
转眼便来到了半空之上。
看到虚空之上那道虚影，李光宇连忙拉着紫桃仙子一道朝着那道虚影躬身行礼。
“老祖，这位是我的妻子，紫桃！”
紫桃仙子朝着李北玄盈盈一拜，行礼道，“紫桃拜见老祖！”
李北玄缓缓抬手，脸上带着一抹柔和的笑容。
“好，好，好，都起来吧！”
对于李光宇以及他带回来的妻子紫桃，李北玄心中甚是满意。
“谢老祖！”
李光宇与紫桃仙子对着李北玄再拜，而后便恭敬站在原地。
李北玄看着他们笑道，“光宇，你小子终于是开窍了啊！”
被老祖说得李光宇也都有些不好意思脸上露出讪笑。
李北玄没有理会满脸讪笑的李光宇，而是转头看向万花主宰拱手笑道，“多谢万花道友对我族后辈的照顾，还请道友随我进府尽些地主之谊！”
“北玄道友客气了！”万花主宰看向李北玄笑着回应道。
“光宇现在可不止是你族后辈，他还是吾族紫桃丫头的夫婿，对他照顾也是应该的！”
听到万花主宰所言，李北玄心道果然。
他看了一眼李光宇，当真的好小子。
不声不响的便与北境十三位主宰之一的桃源一族扯上了关系。
这等福缘，寻常人可是难以企及！

李北玄看向万花主宰笑道，“原来如此，这也是光宇这小子的福气！”
“万花道友，此地并非寒暄之处，我等进府再叙！”
说着，便伸手作请，“道友，请！”
万花主宰面带笑意对他点了点头，“道友，你也请！”
随即，万花主宰挥手便将破虚飞舟收起。
而后便与李北玄一同朝着北玄道域飞去。
李光宇见状，转头看了一眼有些紧张的紫桃仙子，随即伸手拉着她的手安慰道。
“放心吧，老祖他老人家很好说话的！”
紫桃仙子微微点头，“嗯！”
毕竟是第一次上门见李光宇的老祖，虽然自家老祖也在，但她心中依旧难免有些紧张。
李光宇轻轻拍了拍她的手背，“走吧，莫要让老祖们久等了！”
紫桃仙子缓缓点头，而后两人便快速跟上，转眼便消失在了虚空之中。
……
于此同时，人族乃至整个樊墟之地尽皆沸腾。
万花主宰来访？
虽然不知道万花主宰是谁，但那也是一位无上主宰啊！
一个个惊骇地看向人族疆域之外，想要一睹无上主宰的风采。
但是等到他们凝望人族疆域之时，主宰的身影却早已不知去向。
北玄道域之中。
content_en:
As Li Beixuan's voice fell.
Then I saw Li Guangyu flying out of the flying boat with a woman.
In a blink of an eye, he was in mid-air.
Seeing the phantom in the void, Li Guangyu quickly pulled Fairy Zitao and bowed towards the phantom.
"Ancestor, this is my wife, Zitao!"
Fairy Zitao bowed to Li Beixuan Yingying and saluted, "Zitao pays homage to the ancestor!"
Li Beixuan slowly raised his hand, with a soft smile on his face.
"Okay, okay, okay, everyone, get up!"
Li Beixuan was very satisfied with Li Guangyu and the wife Zitao he brought back.
"Thank you, ancestor!"
Li Guangyu and Fairy Zitao bowed to Li Beixuan again, and then stood respectfully.
Li Beixuan looked at them and smiled, "Guangyu, you finally got the idea!"
Li Guangyu was a little embarrassed when his ancestor said it, with a sarcastic smile on his face.
Li Bei
"You're welcome, Fellow Daoist Beixuan!" Lord Wanhua looked at Li Beixuan and responded with a smile.
"Guangyu is not only a descendant of your clan now, he is also the husband-in-law of our clan's Zitao girl, so we should take care of him!"
After hearing what the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers said, Li Beixuan's thoughts turned out to be true.
He took a look at Li Guangyu and saw that he was really a good boy.
He quietly became involved with the Taoyuan clan, one of the thirteen masters of the North.
Such blessings are beyond the reach of ordinary people!
Li Beixuan looked at the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers and smiled, "I see, this is also the blessing of this boy Guangyu!"
"Fellow Taoist Wanhua, this is not a place for greetings. I'll talk about it later when we enter the house!"
After saying that, he stretched out his hand to invite, "Fellow Taoist, please!"
Lord Wanhua nodded to him with a smile on his face, "Fellow Taoist, please invite me too!"
Immediately, the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers waved his hand and put away the Void-Breaking Aircraft.
Then he and Li Beixuan flew towards Beixuan Dao Domain.
Upon seeing this, Li Guangyu turned his head and glanced at Fairy Zitao, who was a little nervous, and then reached out to hold her hand and comfort her.
"Don't worry, my ancestor is very easy to talk to!"
Fairy Purple Peach nodded slightly, "Yes!"
After all, this was the first time she came to see Li Guangyu's ancestor. Although her ancestor was also there, she was still a little nervous.
Li Guangyu patted the back of her hand gently, "Let's go, don't keep the ancestors waiting!"
Fairy Purple Peach nodded slowly, and then the two of them quickly followed and disappeared into the void in a blink of an eye.
…
At the same time, the human race and even the entire Fanxu land were boiling.
The Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers is visiting?
Although I don’t know who the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers is, he is also a supreme Lord!
One by one, they looked outside the human territory in horror, wanting to catch a glimpse of the supreme master.
But when they stared at the human territory, the figure of the master had already disappeared.
In Beixuan Dao Domain.
